purpose: Simple window-to-wall ratio (window area / gross facade area) per building type and facade orientation, for templates when a building model has no measured openings. Constant across eras and states.
orientation_rule: Classify each facade by the compass direction its outward normal faces: N for 315-45 degrees, E for 45-135, S for 135-225, W for 225-315.

single_family.basis: TABULA SE single-family reference geometry: 22 m2 windows on 122 m2 of facade (0.18). The orientation split favours south-facing living rooms and keeps the four-facade mean at 0.18.

multi_family.basis: TABULA SE multi-family reference geometry: 180 m2 windows on 740 m2 of facade (0.24). Slab blocks have windows on both long sides, so the orientation split is mild; the four-facade mean stays at 0.24.

office.basis: EPSM assumption for punched or band windows in Swedish offices. No orientation preference; solar control is a facade property, not a WWR change.

school.basis: EPSM assumption for classroom daylighting windows in Swedish schools. No orientation preference.

sources.reference: TABULA SE reference building geometry (SE.N.SFH/MFH.*.Gen.ReEx.001), as extracted in epsm_rc references/tabula_swedish_data.json
